description: This Java class defines BOMNode, representing a component in a bill of materials within a manufacturing context. It includes methods for loading children and parent nodes, substitution logic, manufacturing order creation, and various utility functions related to BOM structure and product management.

classes.name: BOMNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a bill of materials tree, with methods for managing BOM structure, substitutions, manufacturing orders, and product relations.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads child nodes based on product associations, applying configurator rules and handling substitutions.

methods.name: loadParents
methods.description: Loads parent nodes based on product associations, supporting bidirectional BOM traversal.

methods.name: getRootNode
methods.description: Returns the root node of the BOM tree.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Recursively prints the BOM structure for debugging.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Collects products in packaging units within the BOM.

methods.name: sumQuantity
methods.description: Aggregates quantities of products across BOM nodes.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrder
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders and production runs for the BOM node and its children.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the earliest start date for manufacturing based on BOM structure.

methods.name: isWarehouseManaged
methods.description: Checks if the product is managed in a warehouse with stock targets.

methods.name: isManufactured
methods.description: Determines if the product is considered manufactured based on supplier and BOM data.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the BOM node is configured, including virtual nodes.
